arxiv-2212-03614.title: A mathematical theory for mass lumping and its generalization with applications to isogeometric analysis
arxiv-2212-03614.creator: Yannis Voet, Espen Sande, Annalisa Buffa
arxiv-2212-03614.description: Abstract Explicit time integration schemes coupled with Galerkin discretizations of time-dependent partial differential equations require solving a linear system with the mass matrix at each time step. For applications in structural dynamics, the solution of the linear system is frequently approximated through so-called mass lumping, which consists in replacing the mass matrix by some diagonal approximation.

arxiv-2212-08260.title: End-to-End Learning to Warm-Start for Real-Time Quadratic Optimization
arxiv-2212-08260.creator: Rajiv Sambharya, Georgina Hall, Brandon Amos, Bartolomeo Stellato
arxiv-2212-08260.description: Abstract First-order methods are widely used to solve convex quadratic programs (QPs) in real-time applications because of their low per-iteration cost. However, they can suffer from slow convergence to accurate solutions. In this paper, we present a framework which learns an effective warm-start for a popular first-order method in real-time applications, Douglas-Rachford (DR) splitting, across a family of parametric QPs.

arxiv-2502-01685.title: Automated Extraction of Spatio-Semantic Graphs for Identifying Cognitive Impairment
arxiv-2502-01685.creator: Si-Ioi Ng 1 , Pranav S. Ambadi 1 , Kimberly D. Mueller 2 , Julie Liss 1 , Visar Berisha 1
arxiv-2502-01685.description: Abstract Existing methods for analyzing linguistic content from picture descriptions for assessment of cognitive-linguistic impairment often overlook the participant’s visual narrative path, which typically requires eye tracking to assess. Spatio-semantic graphs are a useful tool for analyzing this narrative path from transcripts alone, however they are limited by the need for manual tagging of content information units (CIUs).

arxiv-2505-20162.title: Capability-Based Scaling Laws for LLM Red-Teaming
arxiv-2505-20162.creator: Alexander Panfilov, Paul Kassianik, Maksym Andriushchenko, Jonas Geiping
arxiv-2505-20162.description: Abstract As large language models grow in capability and agency, identifying vulnerabilities through red-teaming becomes vital for safe deployment. However, traditional prompt-engineering approaches may prove ineffective once red-teaming turns into a weak-to-strong problem, where target models surpass red-teamers in capabilities. To study this shift, we frame red-teaming through the lens of the capability gap between attacker and target.

arxiv-2510-11836.title: Shift vector symmetry in the Alcubierre warp drive spacetime geometry
arxiv-2510-11836.creator: Osvaldo L. Santos-Pereira, Everton M. C. Abreu, Marcelo B. Ribeiro
arxiv-2510-11836.description: Abstract This work explores the set of coupled partial differential equations of the Einstein equations yielding vacuum solutions in the original Alcubierre warp drive metric with the cosmological constant. It is shown that under an appropriate ansatz they reveal a Burgers-type equation and a heat-type equation.

pmc-10482900.title: Synchronization of spin-driven limit cycle oscillators optically levitated in vacuum
pmc-10482900.creator: Oto Brzobohatý, Martin Duchaň, Petr Jákl, Jan Ježek, Martin Šiler, Pavel Zemánek, Stephen H. Simpson
pmc-10482900.description: We explore, experimentally and theoretically, the emergence of coherent coupled oscillations and synchronization between a pair of non-Hermitian, stochastic, opto-mechanical oscillators, levitated in vacuum. Each oscillator consists of a polystyrene microsphere trapped in a circularly polarized, counter-propagating Gaussian laser beam. Non-conservative, azimuthal forces, deriving from inhomogeneous optical spin, push the micro-particles out of thermodynamic equilibrium.

pmc-11439705.title: LC-MS/MS-based metabolomics and proteomics reveal the intervention of Kangnian decoction on the postoperative intestinal adhesion of rats
pmc-11439705.creator: Liang Jin, Yuan Zhao, Xiaojing Qian, Lingyun Pan, Long Chen, Jingwen Feng, Xinhua Liu, Xiaotong Lu
pmc-11439705.description: BackgroundPostoperative Intestinal Adhesions (PIAs) remain a significant complication of abdominal surgery that can cause pain, infertility, and a potentially lethal bowel obstruction. Kangnian (KN) decoction, a Traditional Chinese Medicine prescription, has been shown to be effective in treating PIAs. Nevertheless, its underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

pmc-11669188.title: Resting‐State Network Plasticity Following Category Learning Depends on Sensory Modality
pmc-11669188.creator: Sepideh Tabrik, Hubert R Dinse, Martin Tegenthoff, Mehdi Behroozi
pmc-11669188.description: Learning new categories is fundamental to cognition, occurring in daily life through various sensory modalities. However, it is not well known how acquiring new categories can modulate the brain networks. Resting‐state functional connectivity is an effective method for detecting short‐term brain alterations induced by various modality‐based learning experiences.

pmc-12421185.title: Stakeholder perspectives on contextual barriers to the successful implementation of multiple family group therapy in the Lower Manya Krobo District, Ghana: a qualitative study
pmc-12421185.creator: Dorothy Serwaa Boakye, Samuel Adjorlolo
pmc-12421185.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to examine the contextual barriers that may hinder the implementation of multiple family group therapy (MFGT) in Ghana’s Lower Manya Krobo District.DesignAn exploratory, descriptive, qualitative study employing focus group discussions and in-depth interviews.SettingAtua Government Hospital in the Lower Manya Krobo District. Data were collected between February and March 2025.

pmc-12489950.title: Microbial communities from distinct Vitis species shape volatile profiles of fermenting juices while preserving varietal typicity
pmc-12489950.creator: María Laura Raymond Eder, Laura Fariña, Francisco Carrau, Alberto Luis Rosa
pmc-12489950.description: Spontaneously fermenting grape juices represent complex ecosystems resulting from the dynamic interaction between the unique characteristics of a grape varietal and its indigenous associated microbiota. The extent to which specific grape variety volatile compounds versus microbially derived ones shape wine identity remains incompletely understood.

pmc-12538834.title: Mycobacterium farcinogenes-induced lymphadenitis in a pediatric patient: a case report
pmc-12538834.creator: Xingxin Liu, Yongmei Jiang, Liting Liang, Wei Zhou, Linghan Kuang, Jiaji Ling, Wenjing Wu, Ziyi Yan, Jingjing Luo
pmc-12538834.description: BackgroundMycobacterium farcinogenes is primarily associated with bovine farcy and rarely infects humans. This report presents the first documented case of a 6-year-old girl diagnosed with lymphadenitis caused by Mycobacterium farcinogenes, resulting from a left submandibular mass. The case highlights the importance of maintaining vigilance for such infections, even in immunocompetent children.

pmc-12547199.title: Astroglia-mediated neuroinflammation as a putative mechanism of neurological outcomes in COVID-19? Insights from a Brazilian cohort
pmc-12547199.creator: Ethiane Segabinazi, Fernando R Tocantins, Talita Glaser, Tamires Maglio, Nathalia C Oliveira, Andrelissa Gorete Castanha, Fabiele Baldino Russo, Paulo Emílio Corrêa Leite, Anita Brito, Camila Vieira Molina, Gabriela Prado Paludo, Raquel de Oliveira Souza, Simone Ravena Maia Alves, Marielton dos Pass
pmc-12547199.description: NeuroCOVID-19 has emerged as a significant global health concern, presenting a wide spectrum of neurological manifestations, including headaches, brain fog and anosmia. While mounting evidence indicates that SARS-CoV-2 infection compromises central nervous system (CNS) function, the precise processes underlying these effects remain incompletely understood.

pmc-12629091.creator: Lu-lu Chen, Wei Xie

pmc-12659760.title: Emerging technologies for in-field plant virus detection: innovations and future directions
pmc-12659760.creator: Subhankar Sahu, Rabah Boukherroub, Christophe Ritzenthaler, Sabine Szunerits
pmc-12659760.description: Plant virus infections pose a substantial threat to crop quality and productivity, contributing to considerable economic losses in global agriculture annually. Traditionally, laboratories have widely adopted serological techniques, such as ELISA, and molecular methods, including quantitative PCR, for virus diagnostics. More recently, sophisticated next-generation sequencing approaches have been introduced to improve the efficiency and reliability of virus detection and identification.

pmc-13087315.title: Electric-field-reinforced affinitive electrolytes for highly reversible aqueous zinc metal batteries
pmc-13087315.creator: Ming Yang, Bao Zhang, An Duan, Sha Luo, Luyang Ge, Jiaqi Wang, Yuxi Zhang, Yu Feng, Xiao Huang, Yuyang Tang, Jia Yao, Hao Wang, Houzhao Wan, Wei Sun
pmc-13087315.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Aqueous Zn metal batteries offer a safe, low-cost route to grid-scale energy storage yet suffer from dendrite growth and corrosion issues. Conventional electrolyte designs largely overlook electric-field-driven interfacial dynamics such as solvation structure evolution and component redistribution during operation. Here, we propose an affinitive additive strategy featuring high donor number and dipole moment, exemplified by N,N-dimethylurea (DMU), to dynamically modulate Zn2+ solvation and the structure of the electric double layer under operational electric fields.

pmc-13118244.title: Emerging Insights into Hereditary Alpha-Tryptasemia in the Context of Mast Cell Disorders: A Greek Case Series
pmc-13118244.creator: Fotios Koliofotis, Natalia Katrachoura, Niki Papapostolou, Styliani Taka, Maria Martinou, Anthi Bouchla, Sotirios G. Papageorgiou, Michael Makris
pmc-13118244.description: Background/Objectives: Hereditary alpha-tryptasemia (HαT) is increasingly recognized as a genetic modifier of mast cell-mediated disease severity and has been associated with heightened mediator-related symptoms and an elevated risk of anaphylaxis. This study aimed to describe the clinical characteristics, multisystem manifestations, and treatment responses of eight patients with HαT and concomitant mast cell disorders.

pmc-13120171.title: Nano-Engineered Sandwich Interlayers for Simultaneous Functionalization and Delamination Resistance in CFRPs
pmc-13120171.creator: Pengzhe Ji, Yunxiao Zhang, Yunfu Ou, Juan Li, Dongsheng Mao
pmc-13120171.description: Carbon fiber-reinforced polymers (CFRP) are widely employed in advanced manufacturing sectors such as aerospace, wind energy, and new energy vehicles owing to their high specific strength and stiffness. The growing demand for lightweight, high-performance, and multifunctional materials has accelerated the development of structurally and functionally integrated CFRP.

pmc-13128566.title: Invasive pericardial and pulmonary aspergillosis by uncommon Aspergillus species in anti-interferon-γ autoantibody-associated immunodeficiency: a case report
pmc-13128566.creator: Junyuan Tang, Zhijuan Luo, Yunhong Li, Wenbo Jiang, Yunying Weng, Guixin Zhang, Cheng Li, Yuhong Liu, Xuejiao Sun, Lin Chen
pmc-13128566.description: This case report describes a 51-year-old female patient who presented with dyspnea and was diagnosed with invasive aspergillosis affecting the pericardium and lungs, secondary to immunodeficiency syndrome caused by anti-interferon-γ autoantibodies. Diagnosis was established by pericardial tissue metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) identifying Aspergillus udagawae and serum anti-interferon-γ autoantibody testing (titer 1:2,500).

pmc-13151184.title: Early clinical efficacy and safety of different surgical approaches in total hip arthroplasty: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-13151184.creator: Xingfei Wang, Lewei Zhou, Tengbo Shi, Xiangxi Meng, Yanfeng Tang, Chaowei Guo, Chen Yue, Youwen Liu
pmc-13151184.description: BackgroundThe choice of surgical approach in total hip arthroplasty (THA) significantly influences early recovery and complication rates. However, comprehensive evidence comparing the efficacy and safety of multiple contemporary approaches remains limited.MethodsWe conducted a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) from PubMed, Cochrane Library, Embase, and Web of Science (inception to July 2025).

pmc-13155801.title: Clinical presentation differences of lichen sclerosus in pre- and post-menopausal women
pmc-13155801.creator: Fernanda Villar Fonseca, Gabriela Gracia Malinoski, Giorgia Flexa Zambon, Glória Maria Nassar, Helena Maria Prado Domingues, Heloisa Lipski Landarim, Leonardo Grazziolli
pmc-13155801.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objective:To evaluate the clinical differences in the presentation of vulvar lichen sclerosus in pre- and postmenopausal women, aiming to provide insights to improve disease management and promote the health and well-being of affected patients.Methods:This was a retrospective analytical study involving 287 women diagnosed with vulvar lichen sclerosus, conducted between January 2009 and December 2023 at Erasto Gaertner Hospital, in Curitiba, Brazil.

pmc-13406819.title: Feasibility Study of Intratumoral NRF2 Expression as a Predictive Biomarker for the Effectiveness of Immunotherapy in Patients with Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Treated with PD-1 Inhibitor
pmc-13406819.creator: Yasuto Jin, Yukihisa Inoue, Hiroyuki Shimada, Tetsu Hara, Shohei Yamashita, Mio Yamamoto, Osamu Matsubara
pmc-13406819.description: Simple SummaryCancer immunotherapy with programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) inhibitors plays an important role in the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer; however, its efficacy remains limited. Metabolic reprogramming in cancer cells generates reactive oxygen species and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment.

pmc-13437086.title: The transcription factor BpERF1A enhances drought tolerance in Betula platyphylla by activating dehydrin and ROS scavenging through interaction with BpRAV1
pmc-13437086.creator: Meiqi Zhou, Yuan Zhang, Zhen Miao, Weiyi Bi, Xu Li, Yang Li, Chao Wang
pmc-13437086.description: Although ERF transcription factors (TFs) play critical roles in abiotic stress tolerance, the molecular mechanisms underlying this role remain incompletely understood. This study identified BpERF1A in birch (Betula platyphylla) as a drought-responsive TF through co-expression regulatory network analysis. Expression of BpERF1A was stalwartly induced by drought stress, and drought treatment markedly boosted its promoter activity.

pmc-13577687.title: Piperine disrupts the OFF state of the resting thick filament of rat skeletal muscle, enhancing dynamic contractility in a fibre‐type‐dependent manner
pmc-13577687.creator: Daniel Z Kruse, Jon Herskind, Michel N Kuehn, Annika J Klotz, Anthony L Hessel, Kristian Overgaard
pmc-13577687.description: AbstractThe myosin‐containing thick filament has been shown to alter its resting structure in response to multiple diseases and therapeutics. Changes in thick filament resting structure are caused by myosin heads transitioning between ordered and disordered OFF conformational states. Functionally, this modulation of thick filament structure is a key regulatory step in muscle contraction and a promising therapeutic target.
